title: Comment on progress v8 "Next best build (v8)": who do this progress ?

messages.text:
The lead owns v8 and coordinates it; each part has its own agent.

| part | agent |
|---|---|
| v8 as a whole, landing | lead |
| Countdown roll | fix-cd-roll-ca |
| Countdown faces | de-countdown (parked, landed) |
| End-of-page morph, GPU fix | fix-morph-gpu |
| Accent word | fix-accent-ca |
| Scroll handlers on phones | fix-scroll-cb |
| Top bar colour check | fix-nav-morph |
| Toolbar fix | fix-toolbar-resize |

- The wave integrator, who combines the parts into the build, is not started yet; the lead spawns it when 2 or more parts are ready.
- v8 is now #1 on the board (your priority request, T-114).

What you need to do: nothing.

Correction to my table: scroll-cb, nav-hit-cache and toolbar-resize are not v8 parts. The first two failed their checks, and the toolbar fix has no fix yet. The real v8 parts today: countdown roll, countdown faces, accent word, end-of-page morph (GPU fix).

What you need to do: nothing.
